description: Full detail for one bigiron.com lot by its URL slug: description, sale status, bid count, make/model/year, seller, location, category and (for active lots) current bid / Buy-It-Now price. Slugs come from bigiron_search or bigiron_sold_search result urls (the part after /Lots/). Sourced from bigiron.com/Lots/{slug}.
name: bigiron_lot_detail
title: Bigiron Lot Detail
